what_they_do: LaborUp is an AI-powered recruiting platform for manufacturing companies. Instead of asking skilled tradespeople (machinists, welders, CNC programmers, maintenance techs) to build a resume, its voice AI agent calls candidates, interviews them, and assembles a detailed skills profile, reaching workers who aren't findable on LinkedIn or Indeed. Manufacturers submit hard-to-fill roles and get matched against this pre-vetted worker network, replacing the manual, resume-based sourcing and screening process traditional staffing agencies use.
theme_fit_rationale: LaborUp embeds into the voice conversation where a skilled trades worker actually describes their experience, and uses that first-party conversational data to build a system-of-record profile (recruitment is an explicitly named use case under Theme 8). That same unstructured voice data is also the wedge that lets them process an unstructured, offline population traditional systems can't reach (Theme 5).
workflow_artifacts: job requisitions (open roles submitted by manufacturers)

recent_signals.summary: Harmonic headcount data shows LaborUp at 17 employees, up from 16 over the trailing 90 days and up from 9 a year ago (+88.9% YoY). LinkedIn followers also up 7.45% over the trailing 90 days.
